text:
Type: reclaimed wood media console
Use: TV and media storage; living room, bedroom
Style: rustic, mid-century modern, coastal
Materials: reclaimed fir in natural stain, pieced block-wood doors, gold metal base
Colors: light natural wood, brass gold
Shape: long low case, two sliding doors with patchwork wood blocks, open two-tier shelf side, slim gold frame legs, textured front
Feel: warm, natural, relaxed
Goes with: white walls, linen, rattan, brass; rustic, coastal or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Pieced-Wood Reclaimed-Fir Storage Media Console, 63"W, Natural Stain
product.description: The pattern created by the pieced, reclaimed wood construction is visually satisfying, turning this very functional console or slim coffee table into an artistic statement. The 2 cabinets with hinged doors and 2 open shelves create welcome additional storage. 16.54"L x 63"W x 21.65"H Reclaimed fir atop a brass-painted metal base The 2 cabinet spaces with doors and 2 open shelves offer ample storage opportunities, both hidden and on display. A sturdy metal base adds stability while not drawing attention from the beautiful wood pattern. Assemble in 15 minutes or less. Avoid moisture; wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty
